reason: Published 2026-10-03 against every version (<=4.2.0, the latest); no fixed release exists and npm's only suggestion is downgrading astro to 2.10.9. The flaw is in shared-cache max-stale handling on an HTTP server. OpsCanopy ships fully static files to Cloudflare Static Assets with no server; astro uses this library only in the build and the dev server, so nothing exploitable reaches visitors. Remove this entry (the gate fails on stale entries) once a fixed http-cache-semantics or astro release lands, and bump the floor.
